item.text: {"search_note":"I found strong evidence of active support for NPT-style diplomacy and FMCT/nonproliferation language in 2024. I did not find evidence of Kishida personally negotiating or signing a new binding arms-control agreement in 2024, nor of him backing the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons. So the best reading is yes on good-faith support for disarmament/nonproliferation rhetoric and initiatives, but mixed on broader de-escalation because deterrence remained central.","evidence":[{"title":"Address by Prime Minister KISHIDA Fumio at the Hiroshima Peace Memorial Ceremony","publisher":"Prime Minister’s Office of Japan","date":"August 6, 2024","url":"https://japan.kantei.go.jp/101_kishida/statement/202408/06hiroshima.html","summary":"Kishida reaffirmed the Three Non-Nuclear Principles, said Hiroshima/Nagasaki must never be repeated, and called for steady practical progress toward a world without nuclear weapons.
